lines.speaker: x.paula-hartmann
lines.de: Hallo, hier ist Paula. Am Samstag laufen wir nicht wie immer um zehn Uhr. Wir laufen schon um halb neun. Um zehn Uhr spielen die Kinder im Park Fußball.
lines.en: Hi, it’s Paula. On Saturday we’re not running at ten as usual, but already at half past eight. At ten the children are playing football in the park.

lines.speaker: x.paula-hartmann
lines.de: Ich bin um Viertel nach acht am Café. Kommst du auch? Bis Samstag!
lines.en: I’ll be at the café at a quarter past eight. Are you coming too? See you on Saturday!

lines.en: Hello, this is the cinema on the market square. You would like two tickets for Sunday, for the film at 6 pm. The 6 pm film is unfortunately full.

lines.en: Hello, this is the restaurant on the market square. This is a message for Mr Franke. You would like a table for six on Sunday at twelve.
